svg.title: The AI maturity curve
svg.desc: Two dotted maturity curves. For businesses: M1 unify and see, M2 agentic bridges, M3 end-to-end chains, M4 governed enterprise. For people: L1 AI answers, L2 assists, L3 acts, L4 orchestrates, L5 governs. Markers: pharma analytics and marketing at M1-M2; BFSI (2), pharma planning and automotive at M2; airlines and retail and D2C (2) at M3; IT services at M3-M4. Marketing, pharma (2) and automotive at L2; airlines, BFSI (2) and retail and D2C (2) at L3; IT services at L4.
svg.text: AI that answers → AI that acts,
evals, policy and audit at scale
